verdict.rationale: The changelog confirms a metered billing model with included credits, and owners and admins can set a monthly spend limit for usage beyond those credits. That is a budgeting control, not transparent pricing. A hands-on community user found the credit system on the pricing page unclear and could not see the pay-as-you-go cost after hitting plan limits, so budgeting was hard. missing for 10: published per-tool-call or per-connection prices, clear overage rates, documented rate limits, independent confirmation that pricing is understandable before committing.
